result.summary: Several visual problems: a broken/missing restaurant image with placeholder icon, truncated restaurant name, and a partially cut-off category chip and promo card at the bottom.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card shows a large empty gray area with only a broken-image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct image asset for this restaurant or provide a proper fallback image so the card is not empty.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with the end cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or add ellipsis/truncation handling so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' and next chip visible), and the bottom pizza promo card is clipped by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling for chips is clear and that bottom content has enough padding above the tab bar so cards are not cut off.
